segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ladies and gentlemen, the hearing of the Committee on Finance, Subcommittee G, is hereby called to order. Our hearing for today is the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget of the Department of Justice and its attached agencies. We would like to acknowledge the presence of Senator Ping Lacson.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We now call on our committee secretary, Attorney Lina, to acknowledge and place on record our resource persons. Attorney Lina, you have the floor.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Chair. Good morning, Senator Lacson, sir. From the DOJ family, we have the following in attendance: Secretary Frederick A. Vida; Undersecretary Raul T. Vasquez.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Margarita N. Gutierrez; Undersecretary Deo L. Marco; Undersecretary Nicolas Felix L. Ty; Undersecretary Gard M. Candelaria; Prosecutor General Richard Anthony D. Fadullon; Chief State Counsel Dennis Arvin L. Chan; from the Bureau of Immigration, Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Land Registration Authority, we have Gerardo P. Sirios, Administrator.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the National Bureau of Investigation, Melvin A. Matiwag, the Director.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Office of the Government Corporate Council, Solomon M. Hermosura.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Office for Alternative Dispute Resolution, we have Jose Maria R. Palaganas, Executive Director.

segments.text: From the Parole and Probation Authority, Wilson R. Suba, Administrator.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Presidential Commission on Good Government, Justice Melchor Quirino C. Sadang, the Chairperson.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Bureau of Corrections, General Gregorio P. Catapang, Jr., Director General.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the Department of Budget and Management, Representatives to the DOJ, Mr. Carlos M. Castro, Director.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From the COA to the DOJ, Attorney.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Gumer Guime, Cassandra Conde, and Imelda Baguiza.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: That's all for now, Mr. Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Thank you, Attorney Lina. We will now proceed with our opening statement.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Actually, 25 years ago, it's full circle for this representation because I first defended the DOJ budget 25 years ago as Chairman then of the Committee on Justice here in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And so I'm back as Senate Committee on Justice Chairperson, and 25 years later, I will be defending your budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: 25 years ago, kami po ni Senator Ping Lacson ay sabay na halal bilang senador. In fact, I call him my mista in the Senate, batch 2001.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And he's here with us also today.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ngayong araw, gusto natin sukatin ang...

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Proposed 2027 Budget ng DOJ at ng attached agencies nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sukatin natin ang 43.3 billion pesos sa tanong ng karaniwang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya ba nitong ibigay ang mabilis, abot kaya, makatao, at pantay na hustisya?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya bang managot ang dapat managot?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sabi nga, 43.3 billion pesos ang gagasusin natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Tapos, 1.3 trillion naman ang pondo ng gobernong ninanakaw taon-taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya, napakahalaga ng sistema ng katarungan sa ating bansa para matugunan ang nais ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: May dagdag na pondo para sa National Prosecution Service Bureau of Corrections.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Para marinig ang mga biktima, mabigyan ng abogado ang mga mahihirap, at matiyak na makatao at ang pagtrato sa mga nakakulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero bumaba naman ng 23% ang budget ng NBI.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kabilang ang halos 90% na bawas sa capital outlay.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Habang lumalala at nagiging mas komplikado ang cybercrime, mga scams, human trafficking,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang batas, ang software ng bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang justice system naman, ang operating system for ang hardware.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kung kulang sa mga investigador, prosecutor, mga field office, at luma na ang forensic tools at case tracking systems,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Or something, yung mga panahon namin,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Eh, mapuprotektahan ba ang mga maliliit na ating mga kababayan?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Halimbawa, tulad ng mga magsasaka sa agriculture smuggling,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: o ang ating mga anak laban sa online sexual abuse and exploitation.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Mabigat ang pasan ng ating DOJ.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sa 45 agriculture economic sabotage complaints, halimbawa, na na-refer sa DOJ hanggang May of this year,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang binalik para sa case build-up, 35 of 45 returned for additional case build-up.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Nilalamo ng agriculture smuggling halimbawa ang kabuhayan ng mga magsasaka,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: mga ngingisda, at patuloy na mataas ang presyo ng pagkain at patuloy ang gutom.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero nasaan ang mga forfeiture ng mga nagwawasak ng ating agriculture economy?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sa pang-aabuso sa mga bata, inaasahang kumilos agad ang Estado.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero bumaba sa halos 35.7 million pesos

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ang proposed allocation para sa National Coordination Center against OSAEC and CISAEM.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Samantala, uulitin natin 90% ang bawas sa capital outlay ng NBI

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: at 898 sa mga authorized positions ito na nanatiling bakante.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang 2027 DOJ budget dapat maging kongkretong commitment na punan ang mga bakanting posisyon,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: bigyan ng sapat na kagamitan ang mga investigador, pagdugtong-dugtongin ang mga ahensya.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Bumuoon ng mga matibay na kasong ilalatag sa korte, protektahan ng mga biktima,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Secretary Vida and the rest of the team DOJ,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: today we invite you to present your strategic plans and your key performance targets.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Iniimbitahan namin kayong tulungan-punan ang hinihingi ng ordinaryong Pilipino sa DOJ,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: isang sistema ng katarungan na gumagana, agad, mahusay at patas.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Lalo na at pagkain, kabuhayan, kaligtasan at kinabukasan

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ng mga anak natin ang nakataya. We look forward to a productive and candid discussion. Paano ma-o-optimize itong proposed allocation? Paano pa maidadagdag at saan natin kukunin ang idadagdag para magampanan ang mga mandato ng may pinakamataas na antas ng pananagutan, accountability, at transparency?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We now ask Senator Lacson for his opening statement. You have the floor, sir.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: None from this representation, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: With that, we can now proceed. Secretary Vida, you have the floor for your opening statement and your presentation. Go ahead, sir.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Magandang umaga po at maraming salamat po sa pagkakataon. Ako po ang inyong Secretary of Justice, Frederick A. Vida.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Kasama ko po ang iba't-ibang opisyalis at lingkodbayan mula sa pamilya ng Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At para po sa batid na kaalaman ng lahat, ang sampu po na attached agencies ng Department of Justice ay unang-una,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: ang Office of the Solicitor General, ang ating pong Bureau of Corrections, ang Bureau of Immigration, ang Land Registration Authority,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ang Office of the Government Corporate Council, ang Parole and Probation Administration, ang ating pong PCGG, Presidential Commission on Good Government,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: and ang ating pong Public Attorney's Office, at syempre po kasama rin po natin ng Office of the Alternative Dispute Resolutions.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Salamat po, ginagalang at minamahal na aming Senador, Senator Francis Pangilinan, and Senator Ping Lacson.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Salamat po sa pagkakataon para amin pong maihain at maidulog ang proposed budget ng DOJ for 2027.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Ito po, para pong sa bilang ay malaki, 46 billion, ito po ay 0.64% lamang ng kabuang budget para sa susunod na taon ng national government.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At kasama ko po ang iba't-ibang undersecretary.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Assistant Secretary, kami po ay handa na tugunan lahat ng inyong katanungan at paglilinaw.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: At maraming salamat po sa pagkakataon.

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Sa pagpapatuloy po ng aming pong paghain, ng aming proposed budget,

segments.speaker: DOJ Secretary Fredderick A. Vida
segments.text: Nandito po ang aming kasama, si Undersecretary Anika Gran-Ong, para ho ipagpatuloy ang aming presentasyon.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable Chairperson.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The Department's overarching framework is defined by its core mandate to uphold the rule of law and serve the government's principal law agency.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: In pursuit of its vision to foster a just and peaceful society rooted in transparency, accountability, fairness, and truth,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: the Department executes its mission by delivering an effective, efficient, and equitable administration of justice nationwide.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The Department administers the criminal justice system through the investigation of crimes, the prosecution of offenders, and the administration of the correctional system.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Beyond criminal justice, the Department also maintains oversight over immigration, citizenship, and land titling system.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The Department guarantees social justice by extending free legal assistance to our most vulnerable and indigent citizens.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: In the next few slides, we will highlight some of the key operational accomplishments of the Department.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The Department of Justice, through the National Prosecution Service, consistently demonstrated enhanced prosecutorial output and case management efficiency over the past five years.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: handled a heavy total caseload of 428,779 cases.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: 395,780 of these were disposed and resolved,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: resulting in 99.12% of cases resolved within the prescribed 120 days,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: improving upon the 99.08% accomplishment recorded in 2024.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The resolved cases include all those complaints,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: under preliminary investigation, inquest, and motion for reconsideration.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Turning to court dispositions, the Department has consistently sustained high prosecution success rates over the past five years.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: As shown in this slide, the Department poses upward trajectory in terms of PSR.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The PSR rose to 90.84% in 2025 from 90.14% in 2024.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: This performance reflects concrete results of the Department's institutional reforms,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: especially in strengthening pre-trial case buildup, tightening evidence standards, and adopting a proactive role in criminal investigation.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Moving on to our overall agency performance,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: the succeeding slides show our agency physical performance for calendar year 2025 and for the first semester of calendar year 2025.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Under our prosecution sub-program, we maintained high operational output.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The National Prosecution Service attained a PSR of 90.84% in 2025,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: which is further improved to 91.38% in the first semester of 2026.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Further, case disposition rate remained high at 99.12% in 2025.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: As of the first semester, case disposition rate has reached 97.96%.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: The PSR has reached 94.94%, which is expected to increase further by year end.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: For our Witness Protection sub-program, we achieved a 100% success rate across all three key indicators in the first semester of 2026.

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: Further, through our Special Enforcement and Protection Units,

segments.speaker: DOJ Undersecretary Majken Anika S. Gran-Ong
segments.text: we have attained 95.18% successful prosecution on monitored cases in 2025.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang components po ng e-gates project po namin, which aims to not only strengthen border control but also modernize the primary immigration processing,

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: accelerate clearances, prevent fraud, and streamline the immigration processing through biometric verification.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang components po niyan are the following.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: First, biometrics capture device in manned inspection counters.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ang description po nito, it is a self-contained device at manned counters, which will capture the traveler's biometric data, such as fingerprints and facial images, with seamless software integration for operation.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Number two po, yung hardware po ng e-gates.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po yung nakikita po natin.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: These are the gates that allow eligible travelers to clear immigration without going through a manned counter.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ito pong e-gates, they read the traveler's passport, they capture live biometrics, they verify the person's identity against the passport, they check the regulatory records, and open the gates if all checks are passed.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Kasama rin po dito ang automated biometric identification system, o yung tinatawag po nating ABIS.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It's the central system that stores...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It's the central system that stores and matches face and fingerprint data for real-time identity verification and fraud detection.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong e-gates monitoring station.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Ito po ang workstations used by immigration officers to monitor the status and performance of all e-gates in real-time.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The system shows whether each gate is operational, in use, or requires assistance, allowing officers to respond quickly to any issues.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Andyan din po ang border control data.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The secure platform that enables safe, real-time data sharing among border control systems and agencies.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Andyan din po ang administrative back-end system.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The management system for monitoring usage, performance, and configuration of e-gates and related components.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong document verification software.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It displays all verification results performed on the passport within the immigration...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Nakaka-indicate po siya ng any detected anomalies or inconsistencies.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Kailangan po kasi yung communications infrastructure maigi.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Nandun po yung switchers, routers, cabling, tsaka yung Wi-Fi that can securely connect all e-gate components.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong server requirements na kailangan pong kasusan.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The servers host and run core e-gate systems to handle transactions reliably...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Bangsan po po ang system integration.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: It will connect all e-gates and biometric systems with the border control information system...

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: ...and other databases for real-time checks and smooth passenger flow.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Meron din pong backup and disaster recovery.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: Yan po yung kung mag-down yung system, dapat po may backup.

segments.speaker: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony M. Viado
segments.text: The data backups and redundant systems aim to protect information and restore operations quickly.
